main_issue: When and how Agent D can cook strong-smelling fish curry (about twice a week) without the smell disrupting A's work, B's clothes and C's laundry; Sunday evening was agreed for one session, the second weekly session is unresolved.

A-B.evidence: Both object to the smell (T1, T2); A proposes Saturday, B says 'Saturday is fine' (T8), and both accept Sunday evening (T31, T32).

A-C.evidence: Both complain about the smell (T1, T3); A said Saturday and C rejected it, but both accept Sunday evening (T30, T31).

A-D.evidence: A first asked for no strong-smelling cooking, then proposed Saturday for D's curry (T5); A endorsed Sunday evening (T31).

B-C.evidence: Both complained about the smell (T2, T3) and both accept Sunday evening (T30, T32).

B-D.evidence: D asks about the clothes (T6); B accepts Saturday if the door is closed (T8) and later agrees to Sunday (T32).

C-D.evidence: C rejected Saturday and D's laundry workarounds (T10-T28). D moved to Sunday evening (T29), and C said 'Sunday evening works' (T30). C then asked about the second weekly slot (T33).
